verdict.rationale: Pika documents a first-party API ('Pika API Club: One API for 100+ leading … models'), which allows programmatic, non-UI access and so supports headless automation in principle. Nothing in the evidence covers actually running it in CI: no API keys or non-interactive auth, no CLI, no SDK, and no CI examples. The only sign-in flows shown are interactive Google, Discord and email links. missing for 10: documented API reference/auth tokens for non-interactive use, CLI or SDK, CI/pipeline integration guidance, hands-on corroboration of headless operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
